blocks.text: Protect your home and family with the Kidde Multi-Purpose Fire Extinguisher for Home, Office, Dorm, Residential, 1A10BC, 2 Pack. Engineered to combat basic fires in your home including trash, wood, paper (Class A), liquids and gases (Class B), and electrical equipment (Class C), the simple & reliable operation is designed to combat fire hazards using the PASS (Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep) firefighting method. Molded from lightweight aluminum and fitted with a simple-to-read pressure indicator, the durable valve assembly is designed for years of service. The strap bracket lets you mount the extinguisher in an easily accessible place so it’s always ready for an emergency. The easy-to-pull safety pin gives you quick access and an ergonomic, rust and impact-resistant steel handle provides a comfortable grip. Contains 2.5 lbs. of monoammonium phosphate fire-extinguishing agent. Note that the dry chemical agent in this fire extinguisher is non-toxic but may cause skin irritation. Place a fire extinguisher within easy reach and on every level of your home where fires are more likely to start. Residential, single use only. Dispose & replace if used, discharged, or if the fire extinguisher is over 12 years old. UL Listed. 6-year limited manufacturer's warranty.
